contexts.text: Turpentine nuts and almonds = goods of life corresponding to these truths... Almonds = goods of life corresponding to the truths of interior natural.
The reason why almonds have this signification is that the almond is one of the more noble trees...
Almond tree = perception of interior truth; here, being predicated of Jehovah, it = watching over it.
The almonds that blossomed from Aaron's rod for the tribe of Levi also = goods of charity or goods of life.
Three bowls like almonds = what is full as to scientifics from good.
Like the shell of an almond, within which, instead of an almond, there is a new-born adder. DLW 424:2.
